headline: Japan: 10-year government bond yields hit 30-year high on weak data
summary: The yield on the 10-year Japanese government bond reached its highest level since 1996 on Monday. Data showed the economy grew much less than expected in the second quarter.
why: Japan's 10-year government bond is the benchmark for Japanese borrowing costs, and its yield affects equity valuations and global carry trades.
why_moved: Weak second-quarter growth data came alongside the 10-year yield reaching its highest level since 1996.
